messages:
anya: heads-up — saw a ~30% token/sec drop on canary for continuous-batcher after last deploy. dashboard spike at 18:02 UTC.
infra-bot: deploy 2026-03-17T18:00Z finished (sha: a1b2c3d). Canary: batcher-mode=continuous, admission=release/4521.
ryan: can you paste the perf graph? is it steady or sawtooth?
anya: steady drop across all canary hosts, not sawtooth. here's the token/sec diffs (canary vs baseline):
```
host1: -28%
host2: -33%
host3: -31%
```
sam: interesting — did the admission controller change land in that PR? I remember a refactor that toggled max_batch_bytes calculation.
anya: yep PR #4521 changed admission threshold from `max_batch_bytes = min(queue_bytes, config.max)` to `max_batch_bytes = config.max` for cold starts.
leah: that would force smaller batches on cold lanes until prefetch warms KV cache. Could explain token/sec drop.
ryan: confirming: kernel selection logs show more small-batch memcopy path hits; unified-copy kernel usages fell 40% concurrent with drop.
sam: can we get a flamegraph or pprof snapshot from a canary host?
anya: grabbed a short profile: `pprof cpu` shows heavy time in enqueue/serialize loop and increased syscalls. paste: `flat  48%  enqueue_batch::serialize_chunks`
leah: CI perf bot also flagged a regression earlier — 3/16 nightly showed a 22% drop on batching e2e tests but it was marked flaky and ignored.
ryan: ok we should bisect to the PR — but quick action: roll the admission tweak back on canary to confirm. sam can you cut a patch?
sam: on it. pushing revert branch now — diff is tiny, patch: 
```
- max_batch_bytes = config.max
+ max_batch_bytes = min(queue_bytes, config.max)
```
infra-bot: canary config updated (revert/4521-applied) — rolling out to 3 hosts.
anya: after revert +10m: token/sec back to baseline within margin. hosts show unified-copy kernel usage restored.
leah: create a postmortem note: PR changed cold-start admission semantics without validation of prefetch behavior; KV warmup dependency implicit.
ryan: action items:
- revert merged into main (sam)
- add unit + e2e for admission semantics (anya)
- add a perf CI check: token/sec smoke for continuous-batcher (leah)
- annotate kernel hint metrics in rollout dashboard (ryan)

sam: created revert PR #4532, holding main rollback. will follow up on hotfix for admission to respect `queue_bytes` on cold lanes.
anya: filing a quick incident note and marking current rollout blocked until we have perf guardrails. :hand:
leah: also adding a short doc blurb about admission vs prefetch dependencies so future authors see this.
ryan: thanks all — good catch. leaving the thread open for any follow-ups or CI signal changes.
